original: vṛṣādhunā| aprāptaprāptirūpā tu muktiraikyaṃ bhavedyadi| tanna yuktaṃ dvayoraikyaṃ na sidhyati kadācana| bhinnayorbhedanāśe
analyzed: vṛṣa adhunā aprāpta prāpti rūpā tu muktiḥ aikyam bhavet yadi tat na yuktam dvayoḥ aikyam na sidhyati kadācana bhinnayoḥ bheda nāśe

original: vā muktirbhede sthite'thavā| bhedanāśe tayoraikyaṃ ghaṭate śruṇu (....)vrata| bhedesati bhave(...)kya(-)miticenna saṅgatam|
analyzed: vā muktiḥ bhede sthitā ithavā bheda nāśe tayoḥ aikyam ghaṭate śruṇu vrata bhede sati bhava īkyam iti ced na saṅga tam

original: aprāpyāyāstu mukte(....)styekākṣa(...) rādhate| sādhane sati sā muktiraprāpyaiva sa(...)lam|
analyzed: a prāpyāyāḥ tu mukteḥ ti eka akṣa sādhane sati sā muktiḥ a prāpyā eva

original: nityasiddhā(.....)sādhya(....)vacenmatam| sādhyatve satyanityatvaṃ pūrvamevābhibhāṣitam| pradhvaṃsavacca nityatvaṃ kiṃ na
analyzed: nitya siddha asādhya vacet matam sādhya tve sati anitya tvam pūrvam eva abhibhāṣitam pradhvaṃsavat ca nitya tvam kim na

original: syāt(....) viśe(........)ceṣyate| kiṃ ca dhvaṃsasya nityatvaṃ sarvadhā(thā) na bhaviṣyati| acidrūpasya sarva(....)śo
analyzed: syāt kim ca dhvaṃsasya nitya tvam na bhaviṣyati acit rūpasya

original: gamyate ya(...)bhāvatve (...)sādhyatva(..........)nasya tu| (.......)tve tu bhāvatvena hetunā| na sidhyati vināśastu taccennaiva susaṅgatam| (..........)prāgabhāvasādhyatvābhāve satyapi(....)
analyzed: gamyate tu tve tu bhāva tvena hetunā na sidhyati vināśaḥ tu tat ced na eva prāgabhāva sādhya tva abhāve sati api

original: bhāva(....)(-)pradhvaṃsasyāpi tat(...........)sādhyasya bhāvarūpasya tu nitya(..........)vānāmapyabhāvānā(....) nāṃ
analyzed: bhāva pradhvaṃsasya api tad sādhyasya bhāva rūpasya tu

original: (.....) asādhyā(...) nityatvaṃ prayojakam| acetana(-)tvame(..........)bhivārataḥ| cetanasya tu nityatvaṃ śrutirāha
analyzed: asādhyāḥ nitya tvam prayojakam cetanasya tu nitya tvam śrutiḥ āha

original: sanātanī| ta(......) (..........)pyasya rūpiṇī| jñānalabhyā kriyāmātrānnalabhyā(...)muccayāt| jñānaṃ na
analyzed: sanātanī rūpiṇī jñāna labhyā kriyā mātra anna labhyā amuccayāt jñānam na

original: (...)khilaṃ cedaṃ mama rūpa(..........) kriyā tu kārakāpekṣā vibhinnālaṃ nā sadā| atra kriyāyā jñānena virodhādeva
analyzed: khilam ca idam mama kriyā tu kāraka apekṣā vibhinnā alam nā sadā atra kriyāyāḥ jñānena virodhāt eva

original: sarvadā| samuccayo na yujyata ka(..........) gatiḥ| sārūpākhyā ca yā muktaḥ sāmīpyākhyā ca yā parā|
analyzed: sarvadā samuccayaḥ na gatiḥ sārūpākhyā ca yā muktaḥ sāmīpya ākhyā ca yā parā

original: sālokyākhyā ca yā tāsāṃ kevalaṃ karmasādhana(.....)
